name: Arduino CLI 工具链
description: Arduino 编译/烧录 + 串口日志 + 板卡信息 + 卸载。对齐 TrieCode v0.3.11。

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List all installed Arduino development platforms (e.g. Arduino AVR, ESP32, STM32). Shows platform name, version, and architectures.

tools.name: search_boards
tools.description: Search for available development boards by name or keyword. Returns a list of matching boards WITHOUT selecting one. Use this to browse options, then use select_board to pick one.

query.description: Search term (e.g. ESP32, STM32, Uno, nano)

tools.name: select_board
tools.description: Select/change the current development board. Use query to search by name — first match wins. IMPORTANT: this sets the standard FQBN (like esp32:esp32:esp32) for subsequent compile/upload. Do NOT pass the display name.

tools.name: get_board_info
tools.description: Get detailed info about the selected board: specs, architecture, pinout, memory, voltage. Requires select_board first.

fqbn.description: Optional FQBN; uses selected board if omitted

tools.name: install_platform
tools.description: Install an Arduino development platform (compiler toolchain), e.g. arduino:avr, esp32:esp32. Use when compile fails with 'platform not installed'. First download may take a while.

tools.name: uninstall_platform
tools.description: Uninstall an installed Arduino platform by ID.

tools.name: install_library
tools.description: Install an Arduino library by name from the Library Manager. Use when sketch #includes a missing library.

name.description: Library name, e.g. DHT sensor library, Adafruit SSD1306

tools.name: uninstall_library
tools.description: Uninstall a previously installed library by name. Prefer over manually deleting the folder.

tools.name: list_installed_libraries
tools.description: List all installed Arduino libraries with versions.

tools.name: search_libraries
tools.description: Search the Arduino Library Manager by keyword. Returns name, version, author, description.

tools.name: set_board_option
tools.description: Set a board option (FlashFreq, PartitionScheme, CpuFrequency). Use get_board_info first to see available options.

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile/verify the current sketch. Uses the currently selected board. IMPORTANT: call select_board first so FQBN is set correctly. Missing platform cores auto-install on first compile.

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Compile and upload to the selected board and port. IMPORTANT: call select_board and select_port first. Port will be auto-detected if omitted.

port.description: e.g. COM3; uses selected port if omitted

tools.name: list_ports
tools.description: List all available serial/COM ports currently connected. Returns port path and manufacturer.

tools.name: select_port
tools.description: Select the serial port for upload. Use query to search by port address or manufacturer name; first match wins.

tools.name: serial_log_open
tools.description: Open a BACKGROUND serial monitor that continuously records device output into a log buffer (solves 'AI cannot see live TTY'). Use when firmware prints Serial output. NOTE: while open the port is busy — upload pauses it automatically.

tools.name: serial_log_tail
tools.description: Read the most recent lines from the background serial log. Requires serial_log_open first.

tools.name: serial_grep
tools.description: Search the background serial log for a keyword or regex (case-insensitive). Use to find specific lines (errors, sensor values) without dumping the whole log.

tools.name: serial_send
tools.description: Send a string to the serial port (CLI command, AT, firmware input). Requires serial_log_open. A trailing newline is NOT added automatically.

tools.name: serial_log_close
tools.description: Close the background serial log and release the port. Use when done monitoring.

tools.name: analyze_crash
tools.description: Analyze serial log for crash signatures (ESP32 Guru Meditation/Backtrace, HardFault, panic, assertion failed, segfault, watchdog, OOM, heap corruption). Requires serial_log_open + reproducing the crash.

skills.name: 烧录前检查
skills.description: 编译 + 检查板/口选择，确认无误再烧
skills.prompt:
请按顺序完成烧录前的完整检查：
1. read_file 当前 sketch 源码，检查明显错误
2. 确认已选择开发板（select_board）和端口（select_port）
3. 用 compile 编译一次，确保无 error
4. 编译通过后先向用户确认「编译通过，是否烧录？」，确认后再 upload
5. 烧录成功后用 serial_log_open + serial_log_tail 打开串口确认程序正常运行

skills.name: 串口日志分析
skills.description: 打开串口后台日志，读取并分析运行输出
skills.prompt:
1. 用 serial_log_open 打开当前板子的串口后台日志（端口默认 115200）
2. 让固件运行一段时间，用 serial_log_tail 读取最近日志
3. 分析输出中的异常/错误信息，定位问题根因
4. 如需检索特定关键字用 serial_grep
5. 完成后用 serial_log_close 释放串口
